guard: Compare predecessor bytes to the corresponding baseline blob
binding: check_histories compares both predecessor inventories to the immutable baseline before check_successors runs. The amendment receipt also binds each predecessor digest.

guard: Require the scratch target to remain inside the isolated Git repository
binding: The earlier active-topic path set matches fixed repository-relative files exactly. Each patch is restricted to its declared file in a newly initialized scratch repository.

guard: Search the patched README for the setup block
binding: The earlier exact-byte comparison with corrected_document includes the setup block. The manifest binds the patch and applied SHA-256, and the approved publication binds the manifest.

guard: Count the exact label text in the patched README
binding: The earlier exact-byte comparison uses corrected_document, which replaces each label at its unique matching line. The approved publication binds the label register and manifest, and check_delivery still counts labels on current owner main.

guard: Revalidate the owner, gate and pending decision of replayed audit entries
binding: The preceding exact audit comparison replays the committed ledger and redactor at the immutable inventory publication. The approved publication additionally binds both audit digests.

guard: Revalidate the canonical revision when rewriting an origin/main blob read
binding: Story 5.10 check_delivery validates the full owner commit before reading the current README and the full inventory revision before reading current inventory blobs.
check_assessments requires this same binding before reading completion dates and passes it to check_release_notes.

guard: Parse the publication date and compare it with the inventory commit date
binding: The immutable publication record pins the exact verifiedOn value, and check_delivery pins the full inventory revision. Completion still parses that date and orders it against the completion date.

guard: Revalidate decision and role coverage on baseline approval receipts
binding: The previous check matches the receipts against their exact committed baseline blobs. Story 5.10 also replays its explicit decision and role validation before delivery.
